excerpt: Marketing & Creative Hiring Is Surging in Canada Published by: Can X Global Solutions Inc. Marketing is the sector with the highest hiring ambition in Canada in 2026. It is also the sector where the definition of the ideal candidate has changed most dramatically in the last two years. The Numbers Behind the Surge The data from Robert Half Canada’s 2026 Demand for Skilled Talent Report is striking. Seventy-three percent of marketing and creative hiring managers in Canada plan to increase their headcount in the first half of 2026 —
